title: recover-P: (4,3) STNFS over Q(zeta_15) behind a run gate: expected work 2^110.306128969406

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the algorithm of proof.md (with DESCENT.md, field-map.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md, RANK-BRIDGE.md) returns P with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-R, H-X and H-SM, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64)(2^111.662816+2^66) < 2^110.306128969406 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. A run gate (u < K = 7203046717929470803, (K/2^64) x 0.998776 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.998776 and is stopped by a work meter at 2^123.0 units. Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.

experiments.purpose: Audit: algebra, toy pipeline, pool and region, kernels, ledger, gate and claim; descent plan and its recurrence; descent conditioning records and replays (cond_q15.py); generator toy (bm_toy.py). {"descent_mesh": 64|96|384} reruns the descent on a finer mesh.
H-R and H-X on the filtered product-form operator over Z[zeta_12] at 2^12..2^14 (proof.md section 4, RANK-BRIDGE.md).
Z[zeta_12] product-form filtering simulator: N_l/U', N_sw/U' and unit share at log2U 10..15 (proof.md section 4).
